chars.SAAD: SAAD: a young man wearing a navy blue short-sleeve work polo shirt, a light blue cloth apron tied at the waist, dark jeans and white sneakers.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a soft pink hoodie, a long cream skirt, a small brown crossbody bag and white sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan neighbourhood laundry shop with folded clothes on shelves and washing machines behind. Seen from behind the shop counter, head-to-waist framing: GIRL stands at the counter picking up a big plastic bag of folded clean clothes, smiling shyly, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop counter. SAAD leans over the counter and asks GIRL a question with a curious, hopeful face, one hand raised; GIRL holds her bag of clothes and listens, surprised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop. SAAD excitedly explains with both hands drawing a round birthday cake shape in the air; GIRL smiles and listens across the counter.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop counter. GIRL puts her hand on her chest and nods happily as if saying 'with pleasure'; SAAD grins, relieved.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop. GIRL takes out her phone and asks SAAD a question, curious, tilting her head; SAAD scratches his head thinking about the answer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop. SAAD and GIRL both lean on the counter chatting and laughing together for a long time, warm late-afternoon light through the shop window, a wall clock behind them.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop counter. SAAD takes banknotes out of his wallet and holds them out to GIRL, asking how much.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan laundry shop counter. GIRL gently pushes SAAD's hand holding the banknotes back toward him, smiling and shaking her head no; SAAD looks surprised.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Doorway of the Moroccan laundry shop. GIRL walks out with her bag of clothes, looking back over her shoulder with a small mysterious smile; SAAD stays behind the counter, still holding the banknotes, confused and puzzled.
